trace.question:
I haven't sent any payment. Cobalt Labs has two approved invoices, and you asked me to pay one, so I need you to tell me which.

| Invoice | Amount | Due | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-30444 | $3,714.45 | 2026-11-04 | Approved |
| INV-51862 | $6,764.82 | 2026-11-25 | Approved |
| INV-43342 | $3,629.40 | 2026-11-28 | Draft (awaiting approval), so not payable |
| INV-84090 | $6,578.62 | 2026-09-30 | Already paid |

Payments can't easily be undone, so I didn't want to guess or pay both. There are no payments yet from the operating account, so neither approved invoice has been paid already.

Which one should I pay: INV-30444, INV-51862 or both? Both are under $10,000, so neither needs controller approval. Once you confirm, I'll pay by wire (or ACH if wire isn't available), make sure it goes out only once, and report back.

trace.message: Pay INV-51862, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-51862, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid INV-51862 for Cobalt Labs by wire from the operating account.

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-51862 (due 2026-11-25)
- **Amount:** $6,764.82, the full invoice amount
- **Status:** Sent and confirmed. The invoice is now marked paid.

The payment went out once. I used a unique key so it can't be sent twice even if retried. It's under $10,000, so it didn't need controller approval.

I didn't pay INV-30444, since you said it's under dispute. INV-43342 is still a draft waiting for approval.
